calculate_nDCG: calculate the normalized Discounted Cumulative Gain between a similarity matrix and relevancy matrix for cross-modal retrieval evaluation
calculate_mAP: compute the mean average precision from a similarity matrix and relevancy matrix for ranking quality assessment
get_mAP: get mean average precision scores for both visual and text retrieval directions plus their average
get_nDCG: get normalized DCG scores for both visual and text retrieval directions plus their average
calculate_DCG: calculate the Discounted Cumulative Gain for a similarity matrix using relevancy scores and k-counts mask
